g.text: Total cloud-free hours for each gateway
All 24 gateway locations | 6-8 November 2026 | Sorted by clear time
Each row is a named gateway. Clear requires all 25 surrounding mask pixels clear.
Mixed, cloudy and unknown intervals are excluded; each site has 0.5 h unknown.
Hours use 15-minute sample hold, not continuous optical-link measurements.
